Attack on Kuwaiti tanker in Strait of Hormuz, 5 Indian sailors rescued

A Kuwaiti oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, with five Indian sailors on board being rescued with the help of Oman. The incident saw a missile strike on the tanker, reigniting tensions in the region.
